# TextBack Desk

> Done-for-you missed-call text-back for small HVAC, plumbing and electrical companies in the US, UK, Canada and Australia. Run by Jahangir.

## What it is
- An automatic text message sent within about 30 seconds when a business misses a customer's call.
- Text-only. It does not answer or place phone calls.
- Set up and managed for the business; written communication only.

## Key facts
- Pricing: founding price for the first 5 clients is $99 setup and $127 per month; confirmed in writing before payment.
- US texting requires A2P 10DLC registration, which can take days to a couple of weeks.
- Industry figures on the site are from third-party reports, not from the owner's own clients.
